title: Economically Weaker Section (EWS) Residential: 3D BIM & Quantity Take-Off from Revit
author: BIM Earth Consultancy
excerpt: Revit modelling and material take-offs for an affordable housing project, improving quantity accuracy and reducing manual measurement.
content:
**Client Name:** Sikkim Government
**Project Name:** Economically Weaker Section Residential
**Scope of Work:** 3D BIM Modelling with Material & Quantity Take-Off from Revit

### Project Overview

BIM Earth Consultancy provided comprehensive BIM consultancy services for the Economically Weaker Section (EWS) Residential Project for the Sikkim Government. The project focused on developing an accurate and coordinated 3D BIM model using Autodesk Revit to support efficient project planning, quantity estimation, and material management.

### Scope of Services

Our scope included the development of detailed 3D architectural and building models based on the available project drawings and design information. The Revit model was developed with appropriate building components and relevant project data to enable accurate extraction of quantities.

Key deliverables included:

- Development of detailed 3D BIM models in Revit.
- Modelling of major building components and architectural elements.
- Preparation of material quantity take-offs directly from the Revit model.
- Extraction of quantities for major construction elements and materials.
- Organization of model data to support cost estimation and material planning.
- Review of model information to improve quantity accuracy and consistency.
- Delivery of structured BIM data to support project planning and execution.

### Project Outcome

The BIM-based approach provided a reliable digital representation of the residential development and enabled efficient material quantification and quantity take-off directly from the Revit model. This helped improve the accuracy of quantity estimation, reduce manual measurement efforts, and provide a structured foundation for project planning and material management.

BIM Earth Consultancy successfully delivered the modelling and quantity take-off requirements, demonstrating the practical application of BIM for government residential and affordable housing projects.
